residuos_shadcn_removidos: data-open:animate-accordion-down / data-closed:animate-accordion-up referenced two custom Tailwind keyframes that only exist when registered in a tailwind.config.js extension — the project has none (Tailwind v4 CSS-first, no @keyframes added to @theme), so these were undefined/no-op utility classes, dropped entirely (content now shows/hides immediately, no slide animation)

ring-ring/border-ring/text-muted-foreground/text-foreground -> ring-brand-600/text-neutral-900 tokens; not-last:border-b had no color at all (defaulted to Tailwind's built-in gray), added border-neutral-300 explicitly

group-aria-expanded/accordion-trigger:hidden|inline on the chevron icons left untouched — aria-expanded is a real attribute AccordionTrigger sets, unlike the dead data-checked/data-horizontal selectors found in Checkbox/RadioGroup/Tabs
